tools.name: yoga_dublin_prices
tools.description: Every class pass, intro offer and membership Yoga Dublin sells, with its price in euro and a buy_url that opens it in Mindbody's cart. Use this for anything about what something costs or how to buy it. Passes work at all four studios. A contract auto-renews for the same term unless cancelled, so quo

tools.name: yoga_dublin_schedule
tools.description: Yoga Dublin's class schedule: what is on, where, when, who is teaching and a book_url for each class. A class carries spaces_left only once it is nearly full, so no spaces_left means it has room; full and waitlist_open mark one that has gone. Covers yoga, hot yoga, Pilates, Reformer, barre and medit

tools.name: yoga_dublin_classes
tools.description: The kinds of class Yoga Dublin runs: the discipline, the studios and teachers running it in the next two weeks, and the cheapest single class that covers it. Use this for what a class is like or who it suits. Narrow with name to read a class's full description — a broad list leaves the descriptions

tools.name: yoga_dublin_workshops
tools.description: Workshops, courses and teacher trainings coming up at Yoga Dublin, with dates, number of sessions, studio, teacher, price and a book_url. Narrow with name to read one's full description — a broad list leaves the descriptions out.

tools.name: yoga_dublin_studios
tools.description: Yoga Dublin's four studios: Rathmines, Ranelagh, Harold's Cross and Charlemont, with address, phone, a maps link and what each has. One pass works at all four.

tools.name: yoga_dublin_teachers
tools.description: The teachers currently teaching at Yoga Dublin and what each teaches. Narrow with name to read somebody's bio — a broad list leaves the bios out. A teacher is not tied to one studio, so ask yoga_dublin_schedule who is teaching where.
